_help: Universities and colleges whose own admissions pages say international applicants pay no application fee. This one list feeds the page no-application-fee/ and the table in the guide universities-with-no-application-fee (where {{NO_FEE_TABLE}} stands). Each entry: name; country (as the site names it); levels (Bachelor's, Master's, PhD); note (plain text); source (the official page that says there is no fee); and either route (a route slug, when the route is about this university) or school (its slug in the schools directory). Optional more: {href, label} for one link to another page on this site. Only add a university when its own page states the fee is zero.

entries.name: Ghent University
entries.note: No application fee, and low tuition: €2,297.40 or €7,079.40 for a non-EEA master's year in 2026–27.

entries.name: University of Antwerp
entries.note: The application procedure is free of charge.

entries.name: Wageningen University
entries.note: Its application steps and cost table list no application fee; most other Dutch research universities charge €100.

entries.name: University of Twente
entries.note: Free to apply, except master's programmes in three faculties (BMS, EEMCS and ET), which charge €100.

entries.name: Saxion University of Applied Sciences
entries.note: No application fee in its cost table; €9,360 a year for a non-EU bachelor's in 2026–27.

entries.name: University of Vienna
entries.note: No fee, except €50 for bachelor's and diploma programmes with an entrance exam or aptitude test.

entries.name: ISTA (Institute of Science and Technology Austria)
entries.note: No application fee and no tuition for its PhD programme, whose students are employed on a salary.

entries.name: University of Birmingham
entries.note: No application fee for any postgraduate taught course.

entries.name: Alliance Manchester Business School
entries.note: Master's courses are free to apply to, except eight MSc courses that charge £60, among them Accounting, Finance and Business Analytics.

entries.name: Colby College
entries.note: No application fee for anyone, and full demonstrated need met for international students.

entries.name: Berea College
entries.note: Free application, and no tuition for admitted students.

entries.name: Bates College
entries.note: Free for any student to apply, and full calculated need met for every admitted student, whatever their citizenship.

entries.name: Davidson College
entries.note: No application fee for non-U.S. citizens; meets 100% of calculated need for admitted students, though aid for internationals is limited and competitive.

entries.name: Grinnell College
entries.note: No application fee, international applicants included, and 100% of need met for admitted international students who apply for aid.

entries.name: Reed College
entries.note: Application fees waived and no tests required; meets the full demonstrated need of every admitted student.

entries.name: Oberlin College
entries.note: No application fee for the College of Arts and Sciences; meets 100% of calculated need for international students.

entries.name: Denison University
entries.note: No fee to apply, and the same need-based aid and merit scholarships for international students as for everyone else.

entries.name: Clark University
entries.note: No application fee for international applicants and automatic merit scholarship consideration, but it cannot admit internationals who need full funding.

entries.name: Smith College
entries.note: No application fee for first-year applicants.

entries.name: Tulane University
entries.note: No application fee for any of its undergraduate programmes through the Common Application.

entries.name: University of Melbourne
entries.note: No fee for graduate research courses; coursework applicants pay AUD 154.
